g.text: 1. ADuCM355 pin numbers here were transcribed from the Rev. C datasheet pin table.

g.desc: 1. ADuCM355 pin numbers here were transcribed from the Rev. C datasheet pin table.

g.text: Check EVERY pin against the official PDF and the EVAL-ADUCM355QSPZ reference design.

g.desc: Check EVERY pin against the official PDF and the EVAL-ADUCM355QSPZ reference design.

g.text: 2. VDCDC_CAPx and the AVDD_REG / DVDD_REG / DVDD_REG_AD decoupling values must be taken

g.desc: 2. VDCDC_CAPx and the AVDD_REG / DVDD_REG / DVDD_REG_AD decoupling values must be taken

g.text: from the datasheet Applications Information section - placeholders are used here.

g.desc: from the datasheet Applications Information section - placeholders are used here.

g.text: 3. EC Sense ES1 pin order is C-S-R (counter / sense=working / reference), 2.54 mm pitch,

g.desc: 3. EC Sense ES1 pin order is C-S-R (counter / sense=working / reference), 2.54 mm pitch,

g.text: 0.4 mm pin diameter. Confirm against the mechanical drawing of YOUR part number.

g.desc: 0.4 mm pin diameter. Confirm against the mechanical drawing of YOUR part number.

g.text: 4. Sensitivity is strongly temperature dependent (approx. 4 nA/ppm at -40 C to 51 nA/ppm

g.desc: 4. Sensitivity is strongly temperature dependent (approx. 4 nA/ppm at -40 C to 51 nA/ppm

g.text: at +50 C for AG1). Temperature compensation in firmware is mandatory, not optional.

g.desc: at +50 C for AG1). Temperature compensation in firmware is mandatory, not optional.

g.text: ES1-AG1-200 : 40 nA/ppm, 200 ppm FS -> 8 uA FS. RTIA = 100k -> 0.80 V FS.

g.desc: ES1-AG1-200 : 40 nA/ppm, 200 ppm FS -> 8 uA FS. RTIA = 100k -> 0.80 V FS.

g.text: 16-bit ADC over ~+/-0.9 V -> ~27 uV LSB -> 0.27 nA -> ~0.007 ppm/LSB.

g.desc: 16-bit ADC over ~+/-0.9 V -> ~27 uV LSB -> 0.27 nA -> ~0.007 ppm/LSB.

g.text: ES1-AG1-10 : 40 nA/ppm, 10 ppm FS -> 400 nA FS. RTIA = 512k -> 0.205 V FS -> ~0.0013 ppm/LSB.

g.desc: ES1-AG1-10 : 40 nA/ppm, 10 ppm FS -> 400 nA FS. RTIA = 512k -> 0.205 V FS -> ~0.0013 ppm/LSB.

g.text: Keep RLOAD = 100 R (EC Sense recommended load resistor for the ES1 series).

g.desc: Keep RLOAD = 100 R (EC Sense recommended load resistor for the ES1 series).

g.text: Bias: VBIAS/VZERO 12-bit LPDACs, 0.2...2.4 V. 0 mV bias -> VBIAS = VZERO (typ. 1.1 V).

g.desc: Bias: VBIAS/VZERO 12-bit LPDACs, 0.2...2.4 V. 0 mV bias -> VBIAS = VZERO (typ. 1.1 V).

g.text: For biased gases set VBIAS = VZERO + Vbias_target.

g.desc: For biased gases set VBIAS = VZERO + Vbias_target.

g.text: I2C: each ADuCM355 runs as an I2C target. Firmware reads its strap on P2.4 at boot and

g.desc: I2C: each ADuCM355 runs as an I2C target. Firmware reads its strap on P2.4 at boot and

g.text: selects 0x30 or 0x31, so one binary serves both devices.

g.desc: selects 0x30 or 0x31, so one binary serves both devices.

g.text: Layout: guard ring at VZERO potential around every SE net; no soldermask opening under

g.desc: Layout: guard ring at VZERO potential around every SE net; no soldermask opening under

g.text: the sensor sockets; clean with no-clean flux only; keep SE traces < 15 mm; AGND and

g.desc: the sensor sockets; clean with no-clean flux only; keep SE traces < 15 mm; AGND and

g.text: DGND joined at one point under U1/U2; do not route I2C or SWD under the AFE section.

g.desc: DGND joined at one point under U1/U2; do not route I2C or SWD under the AFE section.

g.text: BM pull-ups: pull low + reset = flash-erase recovery

g.desc: BM pull-ups: pull low + reset = flash-erase recovery

g.text: REFERENCE / REGULATOR DECOUPLING (values: see datasheet App Info)

g.desc: REFERENCE / REGULATOR DECOUPLING (values: see datasheet App Info)

g.text: 2 x ADuCM355 dual potentiostat, each an I2C target (U1=0x30, U2=0x31). Programmable bias per channel.
